description: List the review history of a list verification, newest first with cursor pagination: every reviewer action on its claims, or on one claim with `claimId`, optionally only one `kind` of action or one reviewer's (`actorId`). Each entry names the reviewer (or `former` when their account or membership is gone), the time, the action, the reason (`given`, `none`, or `unrecorded` for an action that requires one but was recorded before reasons were required), and the claim's disposition just before and just after (verdict as reviewers see it, override, status). `reviewers` lists everyone who acted on the run (`complete`), or says there are more than it names (`overflow`).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
